item.skt: shrI sarba gu h+ya bi d+hi gar+b+ha a lang+ka ra nA ma
item.coloph: gsang ba thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga'i snying po rgyan zhes bya ba/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bal po'i mkhan po ka na ka shrI dang / lo tsA ba chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /slad kyis rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta ha s+ya badz+ra dang / lo tsA ba dge slong nyi ma rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
